title: Requirement
description: Canonical Requirement stage. The ALOS Backend owns identity, scope, permission, and correlation context; the submitting client and GENESIS can never supply authority. objective, trigger, capability need, and ambiguity semantics are produced downstream by RequirementUnderstanding, not by this stage.

requirement_id.description: Backend-derived stable identifier for this requirement. GENESIS must echo it unchanged in RequirementUnderstanding.
